archive_layout_scope: The manifest also binds external originals at existing canonical diss_results paths; the entrypoint is not the entire archive layout.

complete_private_source_inventory.scope: Complete source inventory and restoration/byte-verification bindings; raw files remain outside Git.

count_scope: Logical verified counts/bytes include historically restored required sources. Byte-verified required sources and distinct physical Sprite paths/bytes are separate. Missing/mismatch are byte gaps; historical implementation unprovenness is a separate, potentially overlapping dimension. Cross-study counts must not be added without deduplication.

gap_summary.example_selection: Deterministic greedy primary-reason/restoration-marker coverage, then canonical-order fill; at most 32 examples.
gap_summary.scope: Counts cover every required logical-source gap. The example array is not exhaustive when examples_truncated is true. Historical and byte dimensions can overlap and must not be added.

required_restoration_gaps_scope: Representative examples; use gap_summary for complete counts and the referenced private master for all source bindings.
